changes: Added DONE experience as a first-class non-authoritative playbook seed source. Source lineage now emits sourceArtifactKind=done_experience from DONE summary, pitfalls, and delivery-check material; seed proposal and candidate approval CLI paths accept --source=done-experience; docs describe the exact JSON field and candidate-only safety boundary; smoke covers real dist CLI observe/propose/apply/approve.
usage: Use lattice playbook_seed_observe --source=done-experience --json, then lattice playbook_seed_propose_batch --source=done-experience --apply --observeDigest=<digest> --limit=<n> --json, then lattice playbook_candidate_batch_approve --apply --manifestDigest=<digest> --json. The result is a candidate playbook only.
expectedOutcome: A newly DONE story can provide DONE experience seed material that becomes a proposal and candidate playbook, while DONE success alone does not record helped and does not activate runtime guidance.
actualTranscript: npm --prefix packages/main run build passed. node packages/main/dist/tasks/playbook-seed-promotion-loop-smoke.js reported 16/16 checks passed, including B-c28f DONE experience observes stable seeds and approves inert candidates idempotently. lattice validate --story=B-c28f --json passed all 32 configured commands and covered 11/11 verification intents. done_required_validate passed packages/main build and root full test suite.
outcomeDiff: No difference: expected DONE experience seed-to-candidate behavior matched actual CLI and smoke output. Automatic evidence-based activation remains Story 2 scope.
limitations: Story 1 intentionally does not auto-activate playbooks, does not backfill historical seeds, and does not count DONE success alone as helped. It proves the continuous new-DONE experience-to-candidate path only.
pitfalls: The story needed two review fix loops: first the CLI schema omitted done-experience, then the smoke used handler paths instead of real dist CLI apply/approve. TEST closure also exposed a done_prepare watchdog/orphan validation-lock issue; waiting for the 120s stale threshold allowed done_required_validate to reclaim the lock safely.
